summary: Reproduced that Scheduler._get_new_batch_prefill_raw scans waiting_queue after a resumed chunk changes PrefillAdder.budget_state() to OTHER or NO_TOKEN. The scheduler now skips only that admission scan when the resumed chunk exhausts a budget, while preserving the scan when the budget remains CONTINUE and preserving final waiting-queue bookkeeping.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: exhausted chunk and total-budget cases each observed two waiting-queue iterations (admission scan plus bookkeeping) instead of one; the CONTINUE boundary passed. Raw output: reports/j-378957bae381/failing_before.log

Passing-after scheduler execution regression: OTHER and NO_TOKEN skip the admission iteration, while CONTINUE still performs it (3 passed). Raw output: reports/j-378957bae381/test_scheduler_chunk_budget_gate.log
Scheduler regression plus the related PrefillAdder budget/admission suite (31 passed, 12 subtests passed). Raw output: reports/j-378957bae381/related_unit_tests.log
Patch whitespace validity. A subsequent optional ruff invocation could not run because ruff is not installed in the prepared interpreter.

gpu_execution_evidence: The reported defect is scheduler admission control flow and the issue explicitly requires no model or device. No GPU/model smoke was used as substitute evidence.
remaining_limitations: No full model-serving or distributed reproduction was run because the issue is deterministically exercised before engine/GPU execution and requires no weights or device.

The regression executes the actual Scheduler._get_new_batch_prefill_raw method with isolated scheduler dependencies and a controlled PrefillAdder budget result; the existing real PrefillAdder unit suite was run independently.
The prepared Python environment does not include ruff, so the optional focused ruff check was unavailable; git diff --check and focused unit tests passed.
